name: Quick Draw
hook: Wait for DRAW! Tap first. Flinch and you foul.
how: Everyone stands still while the tension builds. When the sign says DRAW!, tap: the first tap to reach the host wins the round. Tap too soon and you sit the round out. First to 5 wins.
controls: Click, tap anywhere or press Space
uses: One player's browser picks the moment and judges who drew first, in the order the taps reach it (its own tap gets there quickest); if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Each player's fastest reaction, timed in their own browser.
Bot gunslingers draw at different speeds and sometimes flinch, until enough people join.
ideas: Make it a space duel with laser blasters and aliens
Add fake-out signs like DRAT! that you must not tap on
Make the last round worth double
